title: We saw Beta Technologies' autonomous aircraft for the battlefield. Meet the MV250.
summary: Beta Technologies unveiled the MV250, an autonomous hybrid-electric cargo aircraft, at the Farnborough Airshow in July. Business Insider was there to see why the company believes it could be a valuable tool for the future battlefield.
